mkdir project
mkdir stores
exec card --store stores/shared init --prefix redirect-
cmp stdout $WORK/golden/init.txt
exec sh -c 'printf "version: 1\nissue:\n  id:\n    prefix: redirect-\n    strategy: sequential\n" > stores/shared/config.yaml'
exec sh -c 'printf "../stores/shared\n" > project/.cardamom'
cd project

# Redirect targets resolve relative to the redirect file.
exec card create 'redirect board'
cmp stdout $WORK/golden/create.txt

# A malformed nearest redirect is authoritative and does not fall back.
cd ..
mkdir malformed
exec sh -c 'printf "first\nsecond\n" > malformed/.cardamom'
cd malformed
! exec card list
! stdout .
stderr 'must contain one path'

initialized stores/shared
Automatic local exclusion failed. Add these patterns to .gitignore:
.cardamom/board.sqlite3
.cardamom/board.sqlite3-shm
.cardamom/board.sqlite3-wal
.cardamom/blobs/
-- golden/create.txt --
redirect-1
